# Uniqo: full AI reference

## Summary

Uniqo is a pre-launch financial technology product owned and operated by FrameLabs LLC. The product is being designed as an intelligent card experience that gives people direct control over how payments are made, approved and monitored. Uniqo is not presented as another bank and is not yet publicly available.

## Product positioning

Tagline: The card that thinks before it pays.

Uniqo combines virtual and physical cards with real-time controls, spending insights and payment protection. Publicly described capabilities include instant card freeze and unfreeze, configurable limits, virtual and one-time cards, merchant and country controls, dynamic card numbers, real-time notifications, spending analysis and AI-assisted fraud protection.

## Plans

Arctic is the free plan. It includes the Arctic card and is described with a virtual card, instant notifications, spending insights and card freeze or unfreeze controls.

Midnight is listed at USD 4.99 per month or USD 48 per year. It includes the Midnight card and Arctic features plus up to five virtual cards, instant card-number changes, one-time cards and AI spending categories.

Graphite is listed at USD 9.99 per month or USD 96 per year. It includes the Graphite card and Midnight features plus unlimited virtual cards, merchant control, country lock, time-based card rules, AI fraud protection, a dynamic card number and travel insurance.

Sirius is listed at USD 19.99 per month or USD 192 per year. It includes the titanium Sirius card and Graphite features plus 24/7 priority support, extended travel insurance, express card replacement, first access to limited editions and early access to new features.

Every plan includes one physical card in its own design. Extra cards in the plan design and limited-edition designs (not tied to any plan) are available for an additional fee.

All prices and features are pre-launch information and may change before public availability.

## Availability

Uniqo is preparing access by region. The website currently lists the United States, European Union, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia, Singapore, United Arab Emirates and Japan. Listing a region does not mean the product is already available or licensed there.
